# NodeTool Documentation

> {{ site.description }}

NodeTool is an open-source, local-first visual environment for building AI workflows. Wire image, video, audio, text, and agent models on a node-based canvas. Runs on macOS, Windows, Linux (Studio), or in the browser (Cloud). AGPL-3.0.

## Getting Started

- [Introduction]({{ site.url }}/): Overview of NodeTool — Studio vs Cloud, what you can build.
- [Why NodeTool]({{ site.url }}/comparisons): How NodeTool compares to ComfyUI, n8n, LangChain, etc.
- [Installation]({{ site.url }}/installation): Install NodeTool Studio on macOS, Windows, or Linux.
- [Quick Start]({{ site.url }}/getting-started): Install, run a template, edit and iterate.
- [Your First Workflow]({{ site.url }}/first-workflow): Build a four-node workflow from an empty canvas: connect, save, run, and change it.
- [Agents and Automation]({{ site.url }}/agents/): Install, discover node schemas, validate and run workflows programmatically.

## Core Concepts

- [Key Concepts]({{ site.url }}/key-concepts): Canvas, nodes, edges, workflows, agents, providers.
- [Workflows]({{ site.url }}/workflow-editor): Building, running, and managing workflow graphs.
- [Nodes]({{ site.url }}/nodes/): Catalog of available nodes by category.
- [Node catalog]({{ site.url }}/nodes/catalog.json): Machine-readable node types, inputs, outputs, and documentation URLs.
- [Agents]({{ site.url }}/global-chat-agents): Planning agents, tools, multi-step execution.
- [Models]({{ site.url }}/models-and-providers): Local and cloud model providers.
- [Glossary]({{ site.url }}/glossary): Terminology used across NodeTool.

## Workflow Editor

- [User Interface]({{ site.url }}/user-interface): UI tour and shortcuts.
- [Workflow Editor]({{ site.url }}/workflow-editor): Canvas, ports, edges, execution.
- [Editor Panels]({{ site.url }}/editor-panels): Inspector, assets, models, chat panels.
- [Chain Editor]({{ site.url }}/chain-editor): Linear chain authoring mode.
- [Graph View]({{ site.url }}/workflow-graph-view): Read-only graph navigation.
- [Debugging]({{ site.url }}/workflow-debugging): Inspect runs, errors, logs.
- [Triggers]({{ site.url }}/triggers): Run a workflow on a schedule, on a file change, from a webhook, or manually.
- [Sharing Workflows]({{ site.url }}/workflow-sharing): Share a workflow through view or edit links, manage people with access, and accept share links.
- [On-Canvas Node Editors]({{ site.url }}/node-editors): The editors inside image, prompt, and Code nodes and how edits map to node properties.
- [Templates Gallery]({{ site.url }}/templates-gallery): Browse and open starter workflows.

## Creative Editors

- [Creative Agent]({{ site.url }}/creative-agent): Brief to finished film through a Director agent, storyboard and timeline.
- [Guided Creation Flows]({{ site.url }}/guided-flows): Start an image, workflow, entity, storyboard, video, script, or game from a guided sequence of steps.
- [Entities]({{ site.url }}/entities): Save characters, locations, styles, and props with reference images and reuse them in generation.
- [AI Video Production]({{ site.url }}/ai-video-production): Guided video, storyboard and script flows.
- [Video Editor]({{ site.url }}/video-editor): Multi-track timeline editing and export.
- [AI Timeline Editing]({{ site.url }}/ai-timeline-editing): Generate and revise clips on the timeline.
- [Timeline Motion Design]({{ site.url }}/timeline-motion-design): Timeline document fields for easing, text animators, camera, layout, effects, and transitions.
- [Custom Animations]({{ site.url }}/timeline-custom-animations): Write timeline motion as JavaScript that returns keyframes.
- [Sketch Editor]({{ site.url }}/sketch-editor): Mask, paint, layer, and generate images inline.
- [3D Editor]({{ site.url }}/3d-editor): Block out a set with shapes and lights and render shot references.
- [Blender Nodes]({{ site.url }}/blender): Render 3D models to images, passes and video with headless Blender inside a workflow.
- [Game Editor]({{ site.url }}/game-editor): Build, play and publish 2D and 3D games.
- [Audio Editor]({{ site.url }}/audio-editor): Trim, fade, normalize, and reverse an audio asset and save it back.
- [Text and SVG Documents]({{ site.url }}/text-and-svg-documents): Every document type the + New menu creates, and the text, CSV, and SVG editors.

- [Mini Apps]({{ site.url }}/mini-apps): What Mini Apps solve, where they live, and how the document, bindings, and runtime work.
- [Building Mini Apps]({{ site.url }}/mini-apps-guide): Recipes for generators, streaming apps, galleries, live tuning, and review flows.
- [Mini App Reference]({{ site.url }}/mini-apps-reference): Widgets, binding grammar, actions, conditions, and the document schema.
- [Mini Apps on Mobile]({{ site.url }}/mini-apps-mobile): Opening and running an app from the phone, and what the native runtime does differently.
- [App Builder]({{ site.url }}/app-builder): Design a Mini App's interface and bind it to workflows.

- [HuggingFace]({{ site.url }}/huggingface): Models from the Hub.
- [ComfyUI]({{ site.url }}/comfyui): Run ComfyUI workflows directly, over a GPU worker, or on Comfy Cloud.
- [ComfyUI Setup]({{ site.url }}/comfyui-setup): Getting a ComfyUI endpoint NodeTool can reach, and what must be installed on it.
- [ComfyUI Recipes]({{ site.url }}/comfyui-recipes): Composing a ComfyUI node with the rest of a graph, and running one headless.
- [Models Manager]({{ site.url }}/models-manager): Download and manage local models.
- [Costs & Credits]({{ site.url }}/costs-and-credits): Cost estimates, spend tracking, limits, and hosted credits.

## Integrations

- [Google Workspace and Email]({{ site.url }}/google-workspace): Connect a Google account so agents can use Drive, Gmail, Docs, Sheets and Calendar, or read mail over IMAP.
- [Telegram Bot]({{ site.url }}/telegram-bot): Chat with your NodeTool agent from Telegram: BotFather setup, account linking, allowlist.
- [Apify]({{ site.url }}/apify-integration): Run Apify actors from agents and the sandbox.
- [SerpAPI]({{ site.url }}/serpapi-integration): Search any SerpAPI engine through one discovered capability.

- [Node Reference]({{ site.url }}/developer/node-reference): @prop, types, decorators.
- [TypeScript DSL]({{ site.url }}/developer/ts-dsl-guide): Define workflows in TS.
- [Portable Workflow Runner]({{ site.url }}/developer/workflow-runner): Run a workflow graph from a Web-standard request handler on Node, Bun, Deno, Vercel, Cloudflare Workers, or in the browser.
